h2: Browse Square Face Icon Gallery Examples
How to Use These Gallery Examples
Create Your Own Square Face Icon
h3: Copy the principle, not the exact look
Use the free avatar maker workflow

pageOwnedParagraphs: This gallery pairs simple style illustrations with approved community submissions when available. The eight sample faces in the examples section are illustrations, not game screenshots. Use them to compare expression, contrast, and small-size readability. Display or moderation does not verify authorship or grant image-use rights; check permissions for the specific image.
These public cards come from approved user submissions only. New comments and optional images are reviewed before they appear here, and email addresses are never displayed publicly.
Use this square face icon gallery to compare expression, contrast, and small-size readability before you make a new design.
A friendly profile icon style with soft color contrast and a calm expression.
A brighter avatar idea for TikTok, YouTube, and creator profile pages.
A simple gaming-style icon with clear edges and a readable small-size face.
A warm square avatar that works well for chat apps and small communities.
A cool, clean style for forums, classroom projects, and team profiles.
A playful look with a stronger accent color and a compact centered face.
A low-detail avatar idea for users who want a clean, private profile image.
A bright square face style for friend groups, light projects, and casual servers.
Decide whether the avatar should feel friendly, calm, bold, playful, or minimal before choosing parts.
Use the examples for color balance and readability, then create your own combination in the generator.
A good gallery-inspired avatar should still read clearly when it appears as a small social profile icon.

The examples on this page are intentionally simple because profile avatars are usually viewed at small sizes. If you want a stronger result, focus on one memorable feature: a hairstyle, glasses, a bright background, or a clear smile.
Start with the main square face generator and build your own icon.
Follow a fast process for creating profile-ready avatars.
Learn how to choose softer expressions, colors, and accessories.
